facts.recommendationText: Run a price-realization and discount-leakage analysis and a win/loss price-sensitivity review Quantify the price-realization gap and discount leakage before any price change A price-realization and discount-leakage analysis is analysis-only and reversible; it avoids an across-the-board price increase without elasticity data. The gap is price realization, not cost; the leakage must be measured before any pricing move Measure realized vs list price and discount leakage by deal/rep against comparable competitors. Price-realization gap and discount leakage quantified by segment Review win/loss and willingness-to-pay to size reversible price/governance levers — no blanket hike. Reversible pricing-governance levers shortlisted with elasticity evidence
